accepted_answers.name: PyYAML
accepted_answers.why: The long-standing standard YAML parser for Python: full spec handling of anchors, multiline scalars, and types.

accepted_answers.name: ruamel.yaml
accepted_answers.why: Accepted (often preferred) when round-tripping matters: preserves comments, ordering, and quotes.

notes: Very strong consensus: YAML is a context-sensitive superset of JSON; regex cannot handle anchors, block scalars, or nested maps.
problem: Parsing YAML in Python with regular expressions instead of a YAML parser.
